bullets: description: Novel and clinically relevant images of unusual or striking examples of clinical entities, laboratory/radiological studies, or therapeutic procedures with brief explanatory text.
limits: body up to 150 words (Additional explanatory text (not part of the legend) limited to 150 words or less; figure title 15 words or less; legend 40 words or less)
limits: no abstract and no Key Points
limits: up to 6 references
limits: up to 1 figure
limits: up to 3 authors
limits: title up to 60 characters including spaces
components: the venue names no sections for this type — write into the manuscript's own, and the journal's structure follows what you write
components: signed JAMA Network Patient Permission form for any identifiable patient
components: cover letter — complete contact information for the corresponding author and whether the authors have published, posted, or submitted any related papers from the same study
format: submit a Word document (not PDF); 10-, 11-, or 12-point font, double-spaced, right margins unjustified (ragged).
format: title page, abstract, text, references, figure legends and tables each start on a new page, numbered consecutively from the title page.

format: title page carries the title, every author's full name, highest academic degrees and affiliations, the corresponding author's complete contact information, and the manuscript word count (not including title, abstract, acknowledgment, references, tables, and figure legends).

format: AMA Manual of Style, 11th edition — references numbered in order of first citation, cited with superscript Arabic numerals; up to 6 authors listed, otherwise the first 3 and et al.; journal names abbreviated per PubMed.
format: tables at the end of the manuscript file, numbered in citation order, titles of 10–15 words, 10- or 12-point single-spaced, never as images.

format: each figure a separate file of at most 1 MB; photographs and illustrations at least 350 ppi, line drawings at least 600 ppi; no pie charts, 3-D graphs or stacked bar charts; avoid more than 4 panels.
format: individual files should stay under 500 kB and must not exceed 1 MB; the whole submission under 5 MB (video excluded).
extra: Accepted submissions are published online, noted in the online Table of Contents, and are citable.
extra: Each image should be of high quality in exposure, focus, color, and contrast.
extra: No more than one figure: a single image or no more than 2 related images (eg, a composite showing Figure 1A and 1B).
extra: Simple descriptive figure title (15 words or less) and brief legend (40 words or less) with technical details and all labeled structures explained.
extra: Short descriptive manuscript title of 15 words or less.
extra: Images at sufficient resolution for print (at least 5 inches wide at 300 ppi).
extra: No online supplementary material.
extra: this summary is the app's distillation — open the author instructions above to confirm against the journal's current text.
